title: AC1024 complete constraint-group DXF record writer primitive
scope: Implement a direct DXF record writer for one source-backed AC1024 version-0 inline constraint-group profile when its action and group prefixes and every inline node body are complete. The primitive is not routed through dx_iface; whole-document associative export remains refused.

sourceProfile.limitations: The independent LibreDWG 0.14 DXF output drops class-specific node names/data and is not an exact node-wire oracle. Use it only for base group/action field corroboration; use the independent ACAD Rust DXF writer source mapping for node serialization and retain the limitations explicitly.

independentSources.limits: Independent implementation source establishes the intended DXF field order and AC1024 version-0 to DXF-version-2 normalization; it is not consumer or support-promotion evidence.

implementationBrief.profile: AC1024 ACDBASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP; complete AcDbAssocAction and AcDbAssoc2dConstraintGroup prefix statuses; version-0 inline node list; all node envelopes and class bodies parsed; no opaque node tail; empty action dependencies/owned parameters/value parameters/action body; bounded action/node/vector counts; reject unknown DataKind/class, unsupported node handle roles, extension-dictionary and generic appdata profiles.
implementationBrief.fields: Emit object owner/reactors, shared AcDbAssocAction fields, normalized DXF group version 2, flag/workplane/group dependency/action handles, bounded maxDependencyIndex (preserving the source value 143), next-node seed/count, node class-name and common envelope, then each admitted class body in wire order. Remap every handle by role and preserve null/absent distinctions admitted by the parser.
implementationBrief.failure: Use RecordStateScope and DxfWriterRecordScope. Reject incomplete/mutated/unresolved profiles atomically; failed bytes and identity bindings must roll back and corrected same-object retry must succeed.
implementationBrief.validation: In-memory ASCII and Binary expected numeric projections for each supported DataKind; literal group/action/node order and remapped owner/reactor/action/group/node references; absent optional fields, invalid node-kind combinations, unsupported version/incomplete profile, unresolved-reference rollback, late EED rollback and corrected retry. Keep whole-document DWG associative refusal active.
implementationBrief.fixtures: No persistent DWG/DXF fixture; generate all writer input in memory.

implementationEvidence.result: The direct AC1024 version-0 constraint-group record primitive emits all admitted node DataKinds, validates exact class/DataKind and dependency roles, remaps handles, and rolls back record bytes and source identity on failure. It is not invoked by dx_iface and does not qualify whole-document output.

validation.result: PASS; 1/1 focused fast test, with exact ASCII/Binary projections for all 11 admitted DataKinds, handle remapping, optional-field absence, malformed-profile refusal, unresolved-reference rollback, and late EED failure/corrected retry

nonGoals: Do not add reader/parser fields or change DWG bytes in this packet.
Do not route any associative object through dx_iface.
Do not treat the LibreDWG group output as a complete node-data oracle.
